newsitem.title: UK: Volvo awards ocean contract to Emery CNF.
newsitem.headline: Volvo awards ocean contract to Emery CNF.

text.p: Volvo Construction Equipment Corp - a subsidiary of carmaker Volvo - has awarded Emery a contract to move most of its previous ocean freight business from Sweden to the U.S. by air, Emery said in a press release.
Emery already has Volvo Construction's overnight door-to-door express business to the U.S., Canada and Europe.
The new business amounts to about 4,000-5,000 kilos of stock orders daily from Volvo Construction's spare parts distribution centre just west of Stockholm to the U.S..

Most of the shipments which comprise spares for construction-related vehicles and equipment, go to Chicago where Volvo Construction's logistics centre for North America is located, the release said. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
